_description: 女性品类 Seedream Prompt 服装构造模板。定义每个品类必须在 prompt 中精确描述的细节维度。
_usage: unified_pipeline.py → build_garment_script() 按 category_code 匹配模板，从标签 JSON 提取对应字段生成英文服装描述。

critical_details: neckline shape (V-neck / round / square / boat / halter / sweetheart / collared)
sleeve type and length (sleeveless / cap / short / 3/4 / long / puff / bishop / flutter)
waistline position and type (empire / natural / dropped / wrap / elastic / belted)
skirt silhouette (A-line / pencil / fit-and-flare / shift / slip / tiered / wrap)
skirt length relative to knee (mini above-knee / knee-length / midi below-knee / maxi ankle / full-length)
closure method (back zipper / side zipper / button front / wrap tie / pullover / back keyhole)
DRESS.prompt_instruction: Describe the dress as a single flowing garment — neckline → sleeve → waist → skirt shape → hem length. The waistline placement and skirt silhouette are the most critical details for accurate rendering.

critical_details: waistband type and height (high-waist / mid-rise / low-rise / elastic / structured / paperbag)
skirt silhouette (A-line / pencil / pleated / flared / wrap / straight / circle / tiered / bias-cut)
skirt length (mini / above-knee / knee-length / midi below-knee / maxi ankle / floor-length)
closure (side zipper / back zipper / button front / elastic pull-on / wrap tie)
pleat type if applicable (knife pleats / box pleats / accordion pleats / sunburst pleats)
slit detail if applicable (side slit / front slit / back slit / no slit)
SKIRT.prompt_instruction: Describe the skirt waistband first, then silhouette, length, and any pleats/slits. The silhouette shape (A-line vs pencil vs pleated) dramatically changes the overall look.

critical_details: neckline and collar type (classic point collar / Peter Pan collar / bow tie neck / ruffled collar / band collar / V-neck / open collar)
sleeve type and length (short / 3/4 / long / puff sleeve / bishop sleeve / flutter sleeve / balloon sleeve / cape sleeve)
cuff style (button barrel cuff / French cuff / elastic smocked cuff / flared bell cuff / simple hem)
front closure (button placket / hidden placket / tie front / pullover / back zip)
hem and tucking intention (curved hem for untucked / straight hem for tucking / peplum flared hem)
special details (ruffle trim / lace inset / embroidery / puff shoulder / smocked bodice / sheer panel)
BLOUSE.prompt_instruction: The sleeve type and collar are the most defining features of a blouse. Describe them precisely. Mention whether the blouse is intended to be tucked or worn loose.

critical_details: neckline (crew neck / V-neck / turtleneck / mock neck / boat neck / cowl neck / cardigan open front)
sleeve type (long sleeve / 3/4 sleeve / short sleeve / sleeveless knit)
knit stitch pattern (fine gauge smooth / cable knit / ribbed / fisherman / pointelle / popcorn texture)
fit and silhouette (slim body-skimming / relaxed boxy / oversized slouchy / cropped / tunic length)
ribbing detail (ribbed crew neckline / ribbed cuffs / ribbed hem band / side slits)
KNIT.prompt_instruction: The knit texture and fit are critical. Specify the stitch gauge (fine vs chunky) and how it drapes on the body. Ribbed edges at neck/cuff/hem are characteristic knit details.

critical_details: neckline (crew neck / V-neck / scoop neck / boat neck)
sleeve length and style (cap sleeve / short sleeve / rolled cuff / drop shoulder sleeve)
fit (slim fitted / regular / relaxed boxy / oversized)
hem (straight hem / curved hem / raw cut hem / side slits)
TS.prompt_instruction: Keep it simple but precise. Neckline shape and sleeve length are the key differentiators for a t-shirt.

critical_details: neckline (crew neck / V-neck / scoop neck / mock neck / turtleneck / boat neck)
sleeve style (fitted sleeve / balloon sleeve / bishop sleeve / raglan sleeve / drop shoulder)
fit (slim / regular / relaxed / oversized)
cuff (ribbed knit cuff / elastic smocked cuff / simple hem cuff / button cuff)
LS.prompt_instruction: The sleeve silhouette is the defining feature of a long sleeve top. Describe sleeve volume and cuff treatment precisely.

critical_details: strap type (thin spaghetti strap / wide tank strap / racerback / halter neck tie)
neckline (scoop neck / V-neck / square neck / sweetheart / high neck)
fit (body-hugging ribbed / relaxed drape / boxy cropped)
special details (lace trim / smocked back / built-in shelf bra / ribbed texture)
TANK.prompt_instruction: Strap width and neckline shape define a tank top's character. Thin spaghetti straps read as delicate/feminine, wide straps read as athletic/casual.

critical_details: collar type (classic point / button-down / spread / band / camp collar open)
sleeve (long sleeve with button cuff / short sleeve / rolled sleeve styling)
fit (slim tailored / regular / oversized boyfriend fit)
fabric (crisp poplin / soft oxford / flowy viscose / structured linen)
SHIRT.prompt_instruction: Collar type and fabric weight define a shirt's formality. Crisp cotton = structured, flowy fabric = relaxed drape.

critical_details: waist rise (high-waist / mid-rise / low-rise)
leg silhouette (straight leg / wide leg / tapered / slim / skinny / flared / bootcut)
length (full length / ankle cropped / floor-grazing)
pleat detail (front pleats / flat front / no pleats)
closure (zip fly with button / elastic waist / side zip / tie waist)
PT.prompt_instruction: The leg silhouette is the most critical detail — wide-leg vs straight vs skinny changes the entire proportion. The rise (high/mid/low) defines where the visual waistline sits.

critical_details: waist rise (high-waist / mid-rise / low-rise)
leg silhouette (straight / A-line relaxed / slim fitted / wide leg culotte)
length (mini short / mid-thigh / knee-length bermuda)
hem (raw cut frayed / rolled cuff / clean hem / pleated)
SH.prompt_instruction: Length and leg width are the key details. Specify inseam roughly (mini vs mid-thigh vs bermuda). The waist rise affects proportion with the top.

critical_details: jacket type (blazer / bomber / denim jacket / trench / leather moto / chore coat / cardigan jacket)
length (cropped at waist / hip-length / mid-thigh / knee-length)
collar/lapel (notch lapel / shawl collar / stand collar / hooded / collarless)
closure (single button / double breasted / zip front / snap front / open front no closure)
shoulder structure (structured padded shoulder / natural soft shoulder / dropped shoulder / raglan sleeve)
JK.prompt_instruction: The jacket type and length set the overall silhouette. Shoulder structure determines formality — structured = polished, soft = relaxed.

critical_details: shoe type (sneakers / ballet flats / loafers / heels / sandals / boots / ankle boots / mules / slingbacks)
toe shape (round / pointed / almond / square)
heel height and type (flat / low block heel / kitten heel / stiletto / platform / wedge)
color and material (leather / suede / patent / canvas / mesh)
notable details (strap / buckle / logo / contrasting sole / metallic accent)
SHOE.prompt_instruction: Shoes ground the entire outfit. The toe shape and heel height define femininity level and formality. Describe them clearly.

critical_details: bag type (tote / crossbody / shoulder bag / clutch / mini bag / backpack / bucket bag / hobo)
size (mini / medium / oversized large)
material (leather / canvas / nylon / woven straw / suede)
carry style for the scene (hand-held / shoulder strap / crossbody worn / backpack both straps)
BAG.prompt_instruction: How the bag is carried (hand-held vs crossbody vs shoulder) affects the pose and overall styling. Specify the carry method.

critical_details: hat type (baseball cap / bucket hat / straw hat / beret / beanie / wide brim sun hat / newsboy cap)
material (cotton twill / straw / wool felt / nylon / denim)
wear style (forward / tilted back / slightly angled)
HAT.prompt_instruction: Hat type defines the vibe. How it's worn (forward casual, tilted playful, back relaxed) affects the overall attitude.
